text:
rachel: quick design check — run-history arg preview feedback. current row shows full value and it makes scanning hard. thinking: tiny summary + ellipsis icon that opens an inline panel.

devin: agree. hover-only kills touch. toggle should be a button with aria-expanded. label must be very short for compact rows.

priscilla: microcopy options for the toggle: "Preview", "See", "Value". my vote: "Preview". keep it one word, <10 chars.

alex: accessibility notes: when opened, focus => panel heading; announce via aria-live: "Expanded argument preview for <arg>". Escape closes and returns focus to the toggle. do NOT trap focus.

rachel: UI nit — use single-character ellipsis (…) for truncation, not three dots. show type+size for objects/arrays: e.g., "object (3)".

devin: move copy action out of the panel into row actions to avoid accidental copies. copy button aria-label: "Copy sample value for <arg>".

priscilla: localization: keep visible label <= 12 chars. avoid punctuation-heavy strings, some langs expand a lot. l10n-bot: noted — adding loc note to ticket.

alex: visual: chevron should only animate opacity/rotate to avoid layout shifts. ensure contrast >= 4.5:1 on focus state.

rachel: telemetry idea: emit event when preview opened. if usage < 1% hide by default under an overflow menu for dense timelines.

l10n-bot: translation note added to PL-5555.

devin: I'll mock the compact row with "Preview" label + chevron and the summary text. priscilla add copy variants to PL-5555, alex add a11y checklist, rachel will add telemetry stub. sync in 20. :thumbsup:
